role: design law: mass function of the assignment vector on T^N
notes: Its coordinate marginals are the registered \(\pi_i(t)\) of def:p15-factorial-assignment; chosen to avoid the P16 outcome mass q, which it becomes in M_E.

role: assignment vector placing every unit in cell t
notes: Element of T^N; operand t is a treatment cell.

role: structural causal model of a finite assignment experiment E
notes: Vertices 0 (assignment vector) and 1..N (recorded responses); a model in the sense of def:p16-finite-scm.

role: mean-response function of the N recorded responses
notes: Response function in the average intervention effect of def:p16-causal-intervention.

role: common-assignment intervention mean of model M at cell t
notes: Expectation of h under do(V_0 = t1); distinct from the P15 cell means \(\mu_{ab}\) of def:p15-factorial-coding.

role: assignment estimand of a structural model with weights w
notes: Equals the registered \(\tau\) of def:p15-factorial-assignment for M_E (thm:p15-w02b-p15-077-correspondence).

role: model classes with known randomized assignment; with interference allowed or excluded
notes: Model classes in the sense of def:p16-causal-identification.

role: response function of unit i reading its own cell and disturbance
notes: Encodes no interference and stable versions.
Randomization is independence of U_0 from this tuple.

role: identifying functionals of the observed law for a cell and for a weight vector
notes: Linear in the mass function; uses the known design probabilities.

role: assigned-arm mean of recorded responses in cell t
notes: Same glyph as the cell means of thm:p15-factorial-assignment and \(\overline Y_{ab}\) of def:p19-proposed-factorial-design with t = ab.

role: noncompliance class; received treatment; uptake function; received-treatment intervention mean
notes: Theorem-local; D_i is the received treatment (not a design or data symbol).

role: missing-outcome classes; recording indicator; recorded value; recording function; recording probability; missing-value symbol
